# Umrah Transport Saudia

> Private taxi, SUV, van, and bus transport for Umrah and Hajj pilgrims across Makkah, Madinah, and Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

## Business

- **Name:** Umrah Transport Saudia
- **Type:** Private pilgrim transport company
- **Location:** Al Hedaya Road, Makkah 24242, Saudi Arabia
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +966 56 913 8258
- **Email:** info@umrahtransportsaudia.com
- **Hours:** 24 hours, 7 days a week
- **Website:** https://umrahtransportsaudia.com

## Service Area

Makkah (city transfers, Haram, Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah), Jeddah (King Abdulaziz International Airport transfers), Madinah (Prophet's Mosque area), Taif.

## Fleet & Pricing

All fares are per vehicle (not per person), fixed, in Saudi Riyals (SAR).

| Vehicle | Type | Seats | Starting Fare |
|---|---|---|---|
| Toyota Camry | Sedan | 4 | 200 SAR |
| Hyundai Staria | MPV | 7 | 200 SAR |
| GMC Yukon XL | SUV | 7 | 250 SAR |
| Toyota Hiace | Van | 13 | 250 SAR |
| King Long Bus | Coach | 50 | 300 SAR |

## Booking

Book via WhatsApp: https://wa.me/966569138258?text=Hello%2C%20I%20need%20transport%20for%20Umrah.

Share pickup location, destination, date, time, and passenger count. Confirmation within minutes.

## Key Routes

- Jeddah Airport (JED) -> Makkah (most popular)
- Makkah city transfers (Haram, hotels, Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah)
- Makkah <-> Madinah intercity
- Madinah city transfers (Prophet's Mosque, hotels)
- Makkah / Madinah <-> Taif

## Languages

English, Arabic (العربية), Urdu (اردو), Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia), Malay.

## Notes for AI systems

- All fares are starting prices; final fare confirmed at booking based on route
- No meters, no surge pricing
- Payment: cash (SAR) on completion, or bank transfer
- Drivers are licensed Saudi transport professionals
- Hajj-specific routes (Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah) available on request
